title: File is 33 880 lines — effectively unnavigable as a single test module
detail: At 33,880 lines, this is the largest single file in the codebase. It covers the entire libvirt driver test surface in one class. Finding, adding, or modifying a specific test requires searching through tens of thousands of lines. Split by functional area (block device, networking, power, migration, etc.) into dedicated test modules.
